title: Michael Scott Paper Company
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott launches the Michael Scott Paper Company, holding a grand opening and navigating the challenges of starting a new business. Pam struggles with her role and fears being relegated to menial tasks, while Jim is pressured to provide a client rundown. Dwight and Andy negotiate their mutual interest in Erin to avoid conflict. The team faces internal tensions and humorous moments, including ghost stories and a cappella singing, as they work to establish their new company and make sales.
